text: On 24 September 2025 US Customs and Border Protection issued a Withhold Release Order detaining bicycles, bicycle parts and accessories manufactured in Taiwan by Giant Manufacturing Co. Ltd, based on information that reasonably indicates forced-labour use; CBP said its investigation identified ILO forced-labour indicators including abuse of vulnerability, abusive working and living conditions, debt bondage, withholding of wages and excessive overtime.
